address: place des Jardins de Baseilles 14, Erpent, 5101, Belgium
bio: Trendy and buzzy, this small eatery is the epitome of a Bib Gourmand. Whether you go for one of the classics on the à la carte menu (like meatballs in tomato sauce or rib of beef with fries) or for the more modern set menu (featuring Mediterranean ingredients such as mullet), all the food is depicted by wholesome, instantly recognisable flavours. The wine list and the sommelier’s suggestions are greatly appreciated, as is the possibility of purchasing cheese and wine, in particular, from the shop. One final word of advice: take a seat at the counter if available, you’re in for a treat!...
